versions.changelog:
Initial release: read-only forensics of Alibaba Cloud OSS security incidents.

- Provides root-cause analysis and read-only log audits for OSS traffic abuse, AK leaks, hotlinking, and suspicious bucket activity.
- Enforces strict read-only operations; never performs or suggests mutating actions—only supplies containment checklists.
- Runs all diagnostics exclusively via bundled scripts, not by constructing new API or SDK commands.
- Cites OSS official documentation directly via script integration; never fabricates URLs or doc references.
- Clearly defines trigger conditions and boundaries; routes unrelated requests to appropriate sibling skills.
- Attaches clear reporting, error handling, and observability controls on all forensic tasks.
